Wilful ignorance at Waterloo: public housing quality and political stigma in Sydney's largest estate renewal Waterloo 的故意无视：悉尼最大公屋更新中的公共住房质量与政治污名

Michael Zanardo, Alistair Sisson, Cameron Logan &amp; Rebecca McLaughlan · Planning Perspectives 39(6), 1207–1239 (2024) · 开放获取（CC BY-NC-ND 4.0）
Cite as · Zanardo, M., Sisson, A., Logan, C., &amp; McLaughlan, R. (2024). Wilful ignorance at Waterloo: public housing quality and political stigma in Sydney’s largest estate renewal. <em>Planning Perspectives</em>, 39(6), 1207–1239. https://doi.org/10.1080/02665433.2024.2337268

读的时候注意谁在说话：文中两段块引文都是 Brad Hazzard（时任社会住房部长）的话，作者引用是为了反驳；"不再适用""糟糕透顶""污秽"等是政客原话，不是作者判断；规划文件里"孤岛""错配"等也是转述。作者自己的论点集中在"评估 Waterloo"最后两段和结论。

Abstract摘要

Sydney’s Waterloo estate is one of Australia’s largest and most concentrated areas of public housing. There has been an almost two-decade-long effort to renew the estate, with successive governments persistently making the case that the demolition and mixed-tenure redevelopment must happen. In the process, the quality of the housing on the estate has been denigrated and misrepresented. This paper combines a detailed examination of the architectural qualities of the Waterloo estate with a critical analysis of historical and contemporary policy settings and political decisions driving the redevelopment project. It identifies the phases of development at Waterloo since the first buildings were constructed in 1948, describing the key characteristics of the dwellings that were part of each phase and situating them within in the wider story of public housing in NSW. It then evaluates the qualities identified in the buildings on the estate against the government’s own guidelines for new apartment development. This evaluation reveals the extent to which the state government has avoided a good-faith assessment of the architectural quality of the estate. The paper concludes by reviewing planning and policy objectives and highlighting that tenant interests and housing quality have been obscured through the stigmatzation of the estate.

悉尼的 Waterloo 公屋区是澳大利亚规模最大、最集中的公共住房区之一。近二十年来，政府一直在推动这个公屋区的更新，历届政府始终坚称必须拆除并进行混合权属再开发。在此过程中，公屋区住房的质量被贬低和歪曲。本文把对 Waterloo 公屋区建筑品质的详细考察，与对推动再开发项目的历史和当代政策设定及政治决定的批判性分析结合起来。文章梳理了 Waterloo 自 1948 年第一批建筑落成以来的各个开发阶段，描述每一阶段住宅的关键特征，并把它们放回 NSW 公共住房更广阔的历史中。接着，文章用政府自己为新建公寓制定的指南，评估公屋区建筑的这些品质。这项评估揭示了州政府在多大程度上回避了对公屋区建筑品质做出善意的评估。文章最后回顾了规划与政策目标，指出租户利益和住房质量已被公屋区的污名化所遮蔽。

Keywords: Public housing; Estate renewal; Architecture; Design guidelines; Sydney

关键词：公共住房；公屋区更新；建筑；设计指南；悉尼

Introduction引言

The history of public housing in Australia is being rewritten by redevelopment. Estate renewal, which has come to mean demolition of public housing estates and the construction of mixed-tenure residential developments in their place, has gathered pace over the past two decades, mirroring an international trend. State governments, particularly in Victoria and New South Wales (NSW), have driven these transformations on broadacre outer suburban estates as well as in more complex, high-density inner-city settings. In both cases, policy documents and politicians’ pronouncements describe existing dwellings and neighbourhoods as outdated and unfit for twenty-first-century tenants. The estates and their buildings are often cast as failed experiments that are responsible for social dysfunction. Blame is variously attributed to the apparent hubris of mid-century architects and planners, who are accused of embracing and promoting untried and ill-conceived models of development; technical failures and compromises, due to austere financial conditions imposed on their design and construction; and functional obsolescence. While these explanations are often evoked in overlapping ways that lack a coherent accompanying analysis, the calculation that sits behind them is clear. The political leaders and policy advisers who promote this vision of estate renewal intend their audiences to be left with the very clear impression that twentieth-century public housing falls far short of contemporary standards and norms. They rarely shoulder responsibility for any of these failings. But the estates that have been identified as needing renewal are condemned as simply ‘unfit for purpose’.

澳大利亚公共住房的历史正在被再开发改写。公屋区更新（estate renewal）如今意味着拆除公共住房区、在原址建造混合权属（mixed-tenure）的住宅开发项目，过去二十年里这一进程不断加速，与国际趋势同步。各州政府，尤其是维多利亚州和新南威尔士州（NSW），既在外围郊区的大片公屋区推动这类改造，也在更复杂的高密度内城环境中推动。在这两种情形中，政策文件和政客的表态都把现有住宅与街区描述为过时的、不适合二十一世纪租户的。这些公屋区及其建筑常被塑造成失败的实验，要为社会失序负责。责任被归咎于不同方面：战后中期建筑师和规划师的所谓傲慢（他们被指责采纳并推广未经检验、考虑不周的开发模式）；因设计与建造被施加严苛财务条件而导致的技术失败和妥协；以及功能上的过时。这些解释常常以相互重叠、缺乏连贯分析的方式被援引，但其背后的盘算很清楚。推动这种公屋更新愿景的政治领导人和政策顾问，意在让受众留下一个非常清晰的印象：二十世纪的公共住房远远达不到当代标准和规范。他们很少为这些缺陷承担任何责任。而那些被认定需要更新的公屋区，则被简单地判定为“不再适用”（unfit for purpose）。

Such is the case with the redevelopment of the Waterloo estate: the largest estate renewal proposal to date, and one of the largest that could ever be undertaken in Australia. The estate comprises approximately 2000 dwellings across a range of high-, mid-, and low-rise apartment buildings on 18 hectares in Sydney’s inner-south. In December 2015, the NSW Government announced that it would be included as part of the programme formerly known as ‘Communities Plus’; the plan was to demolish the existing buildings and construct seven to eight thousand new apartments in their place, with approximately 30% of these social housing and 70% private housing. The effect of the project would have been to increase slightly the number of social housing units, although the new units would generally have less bedrooms and be able to house less people than those they replaced. The transfer of a portion of the estate into private ownership and sale of the private market units would fund the project as a whole. In August 2023, following a change of government in March 2023, the plan for the project’s first phase – the redevelopment of 749 units in the predominantly low-rise Waterloo South – was revised to 30% social housing, 50% market-rate private housing, and 20% affordable housing (targeted and moderate-income earners, and leased for either a maximum of 30% of gross income or at a 20% discount to market rate).

Waterloo 公屋区的再开发正是如此：这是迄今规模最大的公屋更新提案，也是澳大利亚可能进行的最大型更新之一。该公屋区约有 2000 套住宅，分布在悉尼内城南部 18 公顷土地上高、中、低层不等的公寓楼中。2015 年 12 月，NSW 政府宣布将其纳入当时称为“Communities Plus”的计划；方案是拆除现有建筑，在原址新建七八千套公寓，其中约 30% 为社会住房，70% 为私人住房。这个项目的效果会是让社会住房数量略有增加，但新单元一般卧室更少，能容纳的人也比被替换的单元少。将公屋区的一部分转为私人所有并出售私人市场单元，用来为整个项目提供资金。2023 年 3 月政府更替后，同年 8 月，项目第一期——以低层为主的 Waterloo South 中 749 套单元的再开发——被修改为 30% 社会住房、50% 市场价私人住房和 20% 可负担住房（面向目标群体和中等收入者，租金最高为总收入的 30%，或按市场价打八折出租）。

In the face of a strong campaign by residents to stop or slow the redevelopment plans, the state government – first under the Liberal-National Coalition, and then under Labor since March 2023 – has highlighted the failings of the estate. Former Minister for Social Housing Brad Hazzard initially declared that it was ‘terrible’; the Labor government’s Minister for Housing an Homelessness, Rose Jackson, labelled it ‘not fit for purpose’ and local Member of Parliament Ron Hoenig described it as ‘well past the renewal date’, with residents living in ‘squalor’. But are the units and the living environment on this estate really that bad? Is wholesale demolition for complete reconstruction the best option available to government? And does this approach properly consider those most affected, the existing residents? While resident groups have mounted a vigorous campaign against the project, most of the public debate has focused on how many new units might be acceptable on a redeveloped site. Other ways of conceiving of the estate – repairing, expanding, and refurbishing existing buildings over time, ensuring ongoing security for residents on site – appear not to have not been given serious consideration. One might assume then, given the proposals to date, that all the dwellings are entirely beyond redemption, unsalvageable. But the estate, which took more than a quarter of century to develop, is made up of several very different types of housing, at very different scales, with different plans, and employing completely different construction materials and methods. The government’s all-encompassing appraisal, that they are no longer fit for purpose, throws a veil over the diversity and specificity of what is actually there. It asks us to take as read the idea that the whole estate is truly obsolete, that high-rise towers and slab blocks, as well as low-rise walk-ups and everything in between must go (Figure 1).

面对居民为阻止或放缓再开发计划而发起的强力运动，州政府——先是自由党-国家党联盟，2023 年 3 月起是工党——一直在强调这个公屋区的缺陷。前社会住房部长 Brad Hazzard 最初宣称它“糟糕透顶”（terrible）；工党政府的住房与无家可归问题部长 Rose Jackson 称它“不再适用”；当地议员 Ron Hoenig 则形容它“早已过了该更新的时候”，居民生活在“污秽”（squalor）之中。但这个公屋区的住宅单元和居住环境真的有那么糟吗？整体拆除、彻底重建是政府能选择的最佳方案吗？这种做法是否恰当地考虑了受影响最大的人，即现有居民？尽管居民团体对项目展开了激烈抗争，大部分公共讨论却集中在再开发后的地块上可以接受建多少新单元。其他看待这个公屋区的方式——随时间逐步修缮、扩建和翻新现有建筑，保证居民能继续安稳住在原地——似乎没有得到认真考虑。那么，按迄今为止的提案，人们可能会以为所有住宅都已彻底无可挽回、无法保留。但这个花了四分之一个多世纪才建成的公屋区，是由几种截然不同的住宅类型组成的：尺度差异很大，平面各不相同，采用的建造材料和方法也完全不同。政府那种“它们已不再适用”的全盘评价，给现场实际存在的多样性和具体性罩上了一层面纱。它要求我们把“整个公屋区确实已经过时”当作理所当然，认定高层塔楼和板楼、低层无电梯楼以及介于其间的一切都必须拆除（图 1）。

The purpose of this paper is to evaluate whether the demolition-redevelopment approach favoured by recent governments is ineluctable. The paper combines a detailed examination of the architectural qualities of the Waterloo estate with a critical analysis of historical and contemporary policies and political decisions driving the project. It provides a brief background that delineates the early history of the public housing programme in inner Sydney in the postwar decades before describing and analysing the qualities of each of the main phases of development of the Waterloo estate between the late 1940s and early 1980s, carefully unpacking the different qualities and characteristics of the buildings and their units. This provides basic information about the amenity of the dwellings – daylighting, natural ventilation, privacy, and so on. The paper then looks at how the qualities of the Waterloo estate’s housing align or not with wider ideas about healthy environments and the other factors that inform the NSW Government’s own housing quality standards for new apartments. The paper, furthermore, evaluates the extent to which the existing Waterloo units meet those standards.

本文的目的，是评估近年历届政府所偏好的“拆除—再开发”路径是否真的不可避免。本文把对 Waterloo 公屋区建筑品质的详细考察，与对推动该项目的历史与当代政策和政治决定的批判性分析结合起来。文章先简要交代战后几十年悉尼内城公共住房计划的早期历史，再描述和分析 Waterloo 公屋区在 1940 年代末到 1980 年代初之间各个主要开发阶段的品质，细致拆解各类建筑及其单元的不同品质和特点。这提供了关于住宅舒适性（amenity）的基本信息：采光、自然通风、私密性等。接着，本文考察 Waterloo 公屋区住房的品质与更广泛的健康环境观念，以及 NSW 政府自己为新建公寓制定的住房质量标准所依据的其他因素，是否相符。本文还进一步评估现有 Waterloo 单元在多大程度上达到了这些标准。

This paper, however, is not a condition assessment nor an attempt to document exactly what residents want from their dwellings. It is an evaluation of the basic architectural qualities of the buildings, the resultant amenity delivered and then an assessment of those aspects against the government’s evidence-based design guidelines. Though the buildings and the units are of their time and somewhat mixed in quality, the results of this systematic evaluation raises questions about the underlying rationale for the state government’s estate renewal plan as it evolved across the past decade. In particular, the paper is interested in whether the redevelopment plans – officially referred to as ‘renewal’ – gives due consideration to the needs of the tenants themselves and the possibility of more judicious redevelopment over time. And it asks why the government relies so heavily on stigmatizing the place and its inhabitants and yet seems to have done little in the way of systematic evaluation themselves.

不过，本文既不是一份房屋状况评估，也不试图准确记录居民希望从住宅中得到什么。它评估的是建筑的基本建筑学品质、由此提供的舒适性，再把这些方面放到政府基于证据的设计指南下检验。尽管这些建筑和单元带有其时代特征、品质也参差不齐，但这项系统评估的结果，对州政府在过去十年中逐步形成的公屋更新计划背后的根本理由提出了疑问。本文特别关注：再开发计划（官方称为“更新”）是否充分考虑了租户自身的需要，以及随时间进行更审慎的再开发的可能性。本文还追问：为什么政府如此依赖于对这个地方及其居民的污名化，自己却似乎几乎没做过系统评估？

The emergence of public housing in NSWNSW 公共住房的出现

A hundred years ago, Sydney faced a significant housing affordability and supply problem. The economic boom of the 1920s built prosperity for some, but many missed out, and housing for workers was often inadequate or simply unavailable. The state government intervened to provide worker housing through its Housing Board (1910–1924), initially in a limited way in the innerurban areas of Millers Point and The Rocks, and later more ambitiously at suburban Daceyville and other suburban and regional locations. However, prominent economic and political forces in NSW fiercely opposed this state support for housing and consequently its impact was quite limited in scope. Under this scheme, the state government completed a total of 834 dwellings in greater Sydney for a population that passed one million during the 1920s. Sydney Municipal Council also invested resources in workers’ housing in this period (1912–1927), something entirely new to them. Their efforts reflected a clear vision, but were similarly limited in scope, providing just 165 dwellings for a population of more than 50,000 (Figure 2).

一百年前，悉尼面临严重的住房可负担性和供给问题。1920 年代的经济繁荣让一部分人富裕起来，但很多人被落下，工人住房往往不足，或者根本没有。州政府通过其住房委员会（Housing Board，1910–1924）介入提供工人住房，起初规模有限，集中在内城的 Millers Point 和 The Rocks，后来在郊区的 Daceyville 及其他郊区和地方城镇更有雄心地推进。然而，NSW 有影响力的经济和政治力量激烈反对这种国家住房支持，因此其影响范围相当有限。在这一计划下，州政府在大悉尼地区总共建成 834 套住宅，而悉尼人口在 1920 年代已突破一百万。悉尼市议会在这一时期（1912–1927）也为工人住房投入了资源，这对他们来说是全新的事。他们的努力体现了清晰的愿景，但同样范围有限，为超过五万的人口只提供了 165 套住宅（图 2）。

In the first quarter of the twentieth century, planners and sanitation experts labelled many inner urban locations with strong concentrations of housing constructed in the period between 1850s and the 1890s as ‘slums’, and they were slated for resumption. But with limited provision of new stateprovided housing, most such areas were redeveloped for profitable commercial or industrial uses, or alternatively just remained as they were with the condition of dwellings worsening. Private construction activity all but ceased during the Great Depression of the 1930s and Sydney faced a drastic housing shortage for its growing population. In 1934, the State set up the Homes for the Unemployed Trust to build small cottages for subsidized sale and to supply cheap materials to enable people to build their own house in suburban areas. But the impact of the Unemployed Trust was also limited.

二十世纪头二十五年，规划师和卫生专家把许多集中了 1850 至 1890 年代所建住房的内城地段贴上“贫民窟”（slums）的标签，并计划将其收回。但由于国家新建住房供给有限，这类地区大多被改建为有利可图的商业或工业用途，或者干脆维持原状，住宅状况持续恶化。1930 年代大萧条期间私人建房活动几近停止，悉尼不断增长的人口面临严重住房短缺。1934 年，州政府设立失业者住房信托（Homes for the Unemployed Trust），建造小型独立屋以补贴价格出售，并供应廉价材料，让人们能在郊区自建住房。但这个信托的影响同样有限。

This series of schemes was modest in terms of serving need but did create momentum for a more substantial public provision of housing. By the middle of the decade, a renewed slum-reform movement pushed for ‘abolishing eye-sores’ and providing better quality homes intended to create employment and improve the health of workers. The removal of terrace housing was a key feature of the initiative as this form of accommodation was widely viewed as ‘ugly and monotonous’, lacking in adequate services and subject to overcrowding. It was the stigmatized housing of its day, and in response to pressure the State established the Housing Conditions Investigation Committee in 1936 to enquire into the issue and make recommendations. It concluded that urgent action was required, that the private sector could not or would not provide the quality of housing required without compromising its profits, and therefore that the Government needed to take on this responsibility. On the advice of the Committee, the State established the Housing Improvement Board in 1937 to undertake necessary slum clearance and construct housing schemes. The Board investigated several slum areas (including Waterloo), but only one project was initiated. Located in Erskineville and completed in 1938, the estate ultimately contained just 56 dwellings (Figure 3).

这一系列计划就满足需求而言规模不大，却为更大规模的公共住房供给积蓄了动力。到 1930 年代中期，重新兴起的贫民窟改革运动推动“清除碍眼之物”，并提供品质更好的住房，以创造就业、改善工人健康。拆除联排住宅（terrace housing）是这项倡议的关键内容，因为这种住房形式普遍被视为“丑陋而单调”、缺乏足够的设施并且过度拥挤。它是那个时代被污名化的住房。迫于压力，州政府在 1936 年设立住房状况调查委员会（Housing Conditions Investigation Committee），调查这一问题并提出建议。委员会的结论是：需要采取紧急行动；私人部门无法或不愿在不损害利润的前提下提供所需品质的住房；因此政府需要承担起这项责任。根据委员会的建议，州政府于 1937 年设立住房改善局（Housing Improvement Board），负责必要的贫民窟清理和住房建设计划。该局调查了几个贫民窟地区（包括 Waterloo），但只启动了一个项目：位于 Erskineville、1938 年建成的住宅区，最终只有 56 套住宅（图 3）。

The government halted further projects and funding at the outbreak of World War II in 1939. However, a change in government in 1941 brought with it an increased focus on addressing the questions of slum-clearance and housing. The new McKell Labor Government proposed a single new authority be established to ‘co-ordinate and supervise housing throughout the State’, and develop a ‘long term programme to give the people homes in which they can live in dignity’. In November 1941, the state government passed a new Housing Act establishing the Housing Commission of New South Wales. The Housing Commission assumed the powers and responsibilities of the previous Housing Board, Homes for the Unemployed Trust and the Housing Improvement Board and was charged with delivering ‘adequate housing accommodation’ across the State.

1939 年第二次世界大战爆发后，政府停止了后续项目和拨款。不过，1941 年政府更替后，清理贫民窟和住房问题重新受到重视。新上台的 McKell 工党政府提议设立一个统一的新机构，“协调并监督全州的住房事务”，并制定一项“长期计划，让人们拥有可以有尊严地生活的家”。1941 年 11 月，州政府通过新的《住房法》，设立新南威尔士住房委员会（Housing Commission of New South Wales）。住房委员会承接了此前的住房委员会、失业者住房信托和住房改善局的权力与职责，负责在全州提供“足够的住房”。

The very first projects of the NSW Housing Commission were modest as material shortages and restrictions during and after World War II in Australia limited the state’s ability to construct new buildings. Houses were built in country areas for those employed in the war effort, and soon after, temporary dwellings were erected in more urban areas for those in greatest need. However, at the end of the War, the Commonwealth lent money to the states under the first Commonwealth State Housing Agreement (CHSA) in 1945, allowing the Housing Commission to commence their activities in earnest. Their initial projects were either new estates called ‘neighbourhood developments’ comprised of scores of small free-standing dwellings on large lots in greenfield areas, or smaller infill projects on resumed (or already available) sites in urban areas, often including modestly-scaled apartment buildings. Designs for standard two and three-storey apartment blocks were developed by the Housing Commission by in-house architects as early as 1946.

NSW 住房委员会最早的项目规模不大，因为二战期间及战后澳大利亚的材料短缺和管制限制了州政府建造新建筑的能力。委员会在乡村地区为参与战时生产的人建造住房，不久又在较城市化的地区为最急需者搭建临时住宅。不过，战争结束时，联邦政府根据 1945 年第一份《联邦—州住房协议》（CSHA）向各州贷款，住房委员会这才得以全面开展工作。它最初的项目，要么是在新开发区建造的、被称为“邻里开发”（neighbourhood developments）的新住宅区，由大量建在大地块上的小型独立住宅组成；要么是在城市地区被收回（或已有）地块上的小型填充式项目，往往包括尺度适中的公寓楼。早在 1946 年，住房委员会的内部建筑师就已设计出标准的两层和三层公寓楼。

(Re)making Waterloo（重新）营造 Waterloo

The first redevelopment at what is now known as the Waterloo Estate occurred in 1948 with four three-storey apartment buildings occupying a small site at the northern end of the urban block bounded by Raglan, George, Wellington and Cooper Streets, on land previously partially occupied by air-raid trenches. The buildings were arranged perpendicular to the street frontages with a landscaped setback and together formed a shared courtyard at the centre-rear of the site. Each small brick apartment building had a simple rectangular building footprint, a pitched, tile roof, and contained six two-bedroom units, two per floor, mirrored across a communal stair. Units were relatively small by today’s standards but had highly efficient layouts with well-proportioned rooms in a pin-wheeled configuration around a minimal corridor, kitchen with sit-in meal room, and modern bathroom facilities. A very thin building section, high ceilings and windows to three sides of every unit provided excellent daylight to all areas of the plan and easy cross-ventilation. Few shared walls meant that there was little acoustic or impact noise transfer laterally (Figure 4).

如今被称为 Waterloo 公屋区的地方，第一次再开发发生在 1948 年：四栋三层公寓楼占据了 Raglan、George、Wellington 和 Cooper 四条街围合的街区北端一小块地，这块地此前部分被防空壕占用。这些楼与临街面垂直布置，前面有绿化退让，并在地块中后部共同围出一个共享庭院。每栋小型砖砌公寓楼的平面是简单的矩形，坡屋顶铺瓦，内有六套两居室，每层两套，以一部公共楼梯为轴对称布置。按今天的标准，单元面积相对较小，但布局非常高效：比例良好的房间围绕一条极短的走廊呈风车状排列，有带用餐区的厨房和现代化的卫浴设施。楼体进深很浅、层高较高，每个单元三面开窗，平面的每个角落都有极好的采光，也很容易形成穿堂风。共用墙很少，意味着横向几乎没有空气声或撞击声的传递（图 4）。

The scale of urban redevelopment projects grew quickly as the state government made a concerted push to increase the volume of housing under construction. External architects worked with the Housing Commission to develop bespoke designs for site-specific circumstances on larger sites that had been acquired or assembled before World War II. In 1954, the Housing Commission completed Greenway in Kirribilli on land left over from the construction of the Sydney Harbour Bridge. Designed by D.T. Morrow & Gordon Architects, it contained 309 dwellings, making it the largest residential development in Australia at the time. John Northcott Place in Surry Hills was completed in 1963, this time on land originally assembled by the City of Sydney for housing. It was designed by Samuel Lipson and Kaad Architects and contained 409 dwellings again claiming the title of largest multi-storey public housing development in Australia (Figure 5).

随着州政府全力提高在建住房的数量，城市再开发项目的规模迅速扩大。外部建筑师与住房委员会合作，在二战前已收购或整合的较大地块上，针对具体场地条件做定制设计。1954 年，住房委员会在建造悉尼海港大桥后剩余的土地上建成了 Kirribilli 的 Greenway。它由 D.T. Morrow & Gordon Architects 设计，共有 309 套住宅，是当时澳大利亚最大的住宅开发项目。Surry Hills 的 John Northcott Place 于 1963 年建成，用地最初由悉尼市为建住房而整合。它由 Samuel Lipson and Kaad Architects 设计，共有 409 套住宅，再次夺得澳大利亚最大多层公共住房开发项目的称号（图 5）。

By the early 1960s, several entire urban street blocks in Waterloo had been acquired and cleared, rear lanes removed, and subdivisions amalgamated and prepared for redevelopment. Apartment building designs were along the lines of the small original project in 1948; however, updated standard building plans were being utilized by this time (Figure 6). Rectangular buildings contained collections of either exclusively one-bedroom units, two-bedroom units or three-bedroom units, and were organized two per floor either side of a stair over three storeys. Newer cruciform plan types contained a combination of unit sizes but were collections of four per floor arranged around a central stairwell. Internally, these unit plans had many of the qualities and characteristics of the earlier ones, however, a couple of small differences from the 1948 building design are apparent, including meal rooms relocated to be part of an open-plan living room, the provision of a small balcony to each unit, and the lowering of ceilings.

到 1960 年代初，Waterloo 已有好几个完整的城市街区被收购和清理，后巷被取消，地块被合并，准备再开发。公寓楼的设计沿袭了 1948 年那个小型初始项目的思路，不过这时已开始使用更新版的标准建筑图纸（图 6）。矩形楼栋内要么全是一居室，要么全是两居室或三居室，每层两套，分列楼梯两侧，共三层。较新的十字形平面则混合了不同户型，每层四套，围绕中央楼梯间布置。在内部，这些户型平面保留了早期户型的许多品质和特点，但与 1948 年的设计相比有几处小的差别，包括用餐区被并入开放式起居室、每套增设一个小阳台，以及层高降低。

While they appeared satisfied with this apartment building type, the Housing Commission introduced a significant change at the urban scale in this phase of development. With the availability of entire street blocks the Commission broke with the traditional pattern of aligning housing to the street frontage. They opted instead for alternative angled layouts which no longer strongly defined the street edges with built form. This arrangement instead provided increased and irregular landscaped setbacks and appear almost as if planned from the birds-eye view (Figures 7 and 8). Internally to the block, behind the building line, the space between the buildings became less physically contained or courtyard-like, and more free-flowing. An advantage of the layout appears to be that windows do not directly face opposing buildings and outlook from units is extended further into landscaped spaces. A secondary consequence is that the building entries are not perpendicular to the footpath and are further from the street diminishing the sense of address and sense of ‘front’ and ‘back’, with buildings being perceived ‘in the round’.

住房委员会看来对这种公寓楼类型很满意，但在这一开发阶段，它在城市尺度上做出了一个重大改变。由于拿到了整个街区，委员会打破了建筑沿临街面排列的传统格局，转而采用斜向的布局，不再用建筑形体清楚地界定街道边缘。这种布局提供了更大、更不规则的绿化退让，看上去几乎像是从鸟瞰角度规划出来的（图 7 和图 8）。在街区内部、建筑线后方，楼与楼之间的空间不再那么具有围合感或庭院感，而是更加自由流动。这种布局的一个好处似乎是，窗户不直接对着对面的楼，单元的视野可以更远地延伸到绿化空间里。一个次生后果是，楼栋入口不与人行道垂直、离街道也更远，削弱了“门牌地址”感和“前”与“后”的区分，建筑被当作“四面体”来感知。

In 1968, a project called Mount Lachlan, which includes 52 dwellings, was designed for the southern edge of the Waterloo Estate in the block bounded by John, Mead, McEvoy and George Streets. Comprised of four larger ‘T-shaped’ three-storey buildings, each with four or five units per floor, the project was a return to the earlier 1948 approach of laying out buildings aligned to the street edge. The architectural language of Mount Lachlan is distinguished by a more modern sensibility with a flat roof, blade wall expression around balconies, and features a change in brick tone for spandrels between windows which helps to break up larger areas of wall plane reducing the apparent scale of the building. Another difference is the introduction of short, externalized corridors, or ambulatories, to reach units not immediately adjacent to the staircase. The dwellings themselves, as with the earlier buildings, are compact in plan, with windows on two or three sides providing ample natural daylight and ventilation, and well-constructed of robust materials that have stood the test of time.

1968 年，一个名为 Mount Lachlan、包括 52 套住宅的项目，被规划在 Waterloo 公屋区南缘由 John、Mead、McEvoy 和 George 四条街围合的街区里。它由四栋较大的“T 形”三层楼组成，每层四到五套，回到了 1948 年那种建筑沿街道边缘排列的做法。Mount Lachlan 的建筑语言更具现代感：平屋顶、阳台周围的片墙表达，以及窗间墙使用不同色调的砖，有助于打破较大的墙面、减小建筑的视觉尺度。另一个不同之处是引入了短的外廊（ambulatories），用来到达不紧挨楼梯的单元。和早期建筑一样，这些住宅平面紧凑，两三面开窗，自然采光和通风充足，建造用材坚固，经受住了时间的考验。

While most of the estate is quite flat, the southeastern corner rises steeply and creates challenges for building in those sections. This change in levels would have made the laying out of multiple free-standing buildings with small footprints – of the kind produced on the estate up until that time – a complex exercise. The steep gradient created difficulties for construction and resident access. To address these challenges, the Commission looked beyond their regular in-house design team and sought input from architects in private practice. Lipson, Kaad and Fotheringham designed Madden Place in 1966. It was composed of one larger, single building with 56 dwellings that could respond to the demanding particularities of the site. In 1969 the Housing Commission Special Designs Group were the architects for Camelia Grove, with 65 dwellings, and, like Madden Place, it was configured to respond directly to the underlying contours. Both are large C-shaped courtyard buildings in plan that are serviced by long open corridors around their internal perimeter. They are varied in height, reducing from six to four storeys as the land beneath them rises (Figures 9 and 10). The real innovation in their design is in section where the buildings are arranged as two three-storey walk-ups stacked on top of each other, with on-grade access from the lowest level and access to the fourth level via a bridge from the higher street frontage. This arrangement delivered compliant fire egress while avoiding the need for elevators, which the Commission generally tried to avoid in its buildings, being too expensive at the time as well as being difficult to maintain.

公屋区大部分地势相当平坦，但东南角陡然升高，给这一部分的建造带来了困难。这种高差会让布置多栋小占地独立楼栋（即当时公屋区一直在建的那种）变得很复杂。陡坡给施工和居民出入都造成了困难。为了解决这些问题，委员会把目光投向常规的内部设计团队之外，向私人执业的建筑师寻求方案。Lipson, Kaad and Fotheringham 于 1966 年设计了 Madden Place：一栋较大的单体建筑，有 56 套住宅，能够回应场地的苛刻特殊条件。1969 年，住房委员会特别设计组（Special Designs Group）担任 Camelia Grove 的建筑师，共 65 套住宅；它与 Madden Place 一样，直接顺应下方的地形等高线布置。两者平面上都是大型 C 形庭院式建筑，由沿内侧周边的长开放走廊服务。它们的高度随下方地势升高而从六层降到四层（图 9 和图 10）。设计真正的创新在剖面上：建筑被处理成两个上下叠放的三层无电梯楼，最低层从地面直接进入，第四层则通过一座连桥从较高的临街面进入。这种布置满足了消防疏散规范，同时避免了安装电梯——委员会一般尽量在建筑中避免电梯，因为当时电梯造价太高，也难以维护。

Camelia Grove and Madden Place are much larger than buildings that had been constructed earlier on the estate, making for larger groupings of households with up to sixteen units per floor. A consequence of this arrangement was that many units have only one uncompromised orientation for outlook and visual privacy, with their second orientation facing back to the corridor, often for the window to the second bedroom. For some units, this configuration also means that the living room and balcony faces south and does not receive direct sunlight. Due to the increased number of dwellings, shared laundries and ‘incinerator’ or waste rooms are provided on each floor rather than as a single room at ground floor in the garden areas like the smaller buildings. Internally, units adopt a conventional and compact layout not unlike the earlier buildings and meeting similar standards in terms of space provision and facilities provided. These blocks still have comparably narrow building depths, especially compared with most of today’s residential development in Australia, and include large windows for light and air.

Camelia Grove 和 Madden Place 比公屋区早期建的楼大得多，住户组团也更大，每层多达十六套。这种布置的一个后果是，许多单元只有一个朝向在视野和视线私密性上没有受损，另一个朝向则背对走廊，往往是次卧的窗户。对一些单元来说，这种格局还意味着起居室和阳台朝南，得不到直射阳光。由于住宅数量增加，公共洗衣房和“焚化”或垃圾间设在每一层，而不像小楼那样在花园地面层只设一间。在内部，单元采用常规而紧凑的布局，与早期建筑相差不大，在空间面积和设施配置上达到相近的标准。这些楼的进深仍然相对较浅，尤其是与今天澳大利亚的大多数住宅开发相比，并且都有大窗户保证采光和通风。

In the 1970s, the ambitions of the Housing Commission for the estate dramatically increased. Larger projects in nearby Redfern such as William McKell Place by Morrow & Gordon Architects in 1961 (8–10 storeys, 186 dwellings) and Poets Corner by Peddle, Thorp & Walker Architects in 1966 (three 17-storey slabs with 192 dwellings each) set the precedent for the final stage of Waterloo. The Endeavour Project in the northern portion of Waterloo, built between 1970 and 1976, comprised four 17-storey slabs (named James Cook, Joseph Banks, Daniel Solander and Marton) each with 214 units, and two 30-storey towers (Matavai and Turanga) each with 232 units and designed specifically for aged pensioners (Figure 11). This project became the most visible culmination of the Housing Commission’s activities in New South Wales and possibly the most prominent in the public imagination. Just under 300 dwellings, amongst other buildings, were demolished and several streets and lanes subsumed to make way for the Endeavour Project. All six buildings were set in expansive open space, surrounded by car parking and park-like lawned spaces, with building entries relatively distant from the street.

1970 年代，住房委员会对这个公屋区的雄心急剧膨胀。附近 Redfern 的较大项目，例如 Morrow & Gordon Architects 于 1961 年设计的 William McKell Place（8–10 层，186 套）和 Peddle, Thorp & Walker Architects 于 1966 年设计的 Poets Corner（三栋 17 层板楼，每栋 192 套），为 Waterloo 的最后阶段立下了先例。1970 至 1976 年间在 Waterloo 北部建成的Endeavour 项目，包括四栋 17 层板楼（分别命名为 James Cook、Joseph Banks、Daniel Solander 和 Marton），每栋 214 套；以及两栋 30 层塔楼（Matavai 和 Turanga），每栋 232 套，专为领取养老金的老人设计（图 11）。这个项目成为住房委员会在新南威尔士州活动最显眼的集大成之作，也可能是在公众想象中最突出的一个。为了给 Endeavour 项目腾出地方，近 300 套住宅连同其他建筑被拆除，几条街道和巷子被并入。全部六栋楼都坐落在宽阔的开敞空间中，四周是停车场和公园式草坪，楼栋入口离街道相对较远。

The repetitive nature of tall building floor plates coupled with pre-cast concrete construction technology allowed for rapid building at scale and was able to utilize the provision of lifts to their fullest. The typical floor of the cruciform-plan towers includes a north-facing community room at each lift lobby, south-facing laundry, drying and garbage rooms, and eight small units arrayed around a dual lift core and ‘scissor’ fire stairs. Seven of the eight units on each floor are bedsit flats comprised of a kitchen, bathroom and single combined space for living and bedroom with windows to a single orientation north, east or west. The eighth is a one-bedroom unit. Southfacing units were given windows in a second direction providing some sunlight access, but no units had balconies and ceilings are relatively low. At the ground floor, a lift lobby, letterbox area, office, sitting room, and community room contribute additional shared facilities. Externally, the provision of a generous fenced landscaped area with seating, shelter, and water features defined a secure communal garden (Figure 12).

高层楼层平面的重复性，加上预制混凝土建造技术，使大规模快速建造成为可能，也能充分利用电梯。十字形塔楼的标准层包括：每个电梯厅旁一间朝北的社区活动室，朝南的洗衣、晾晒和垃圾间，以及围绕双电梯核心筒和“剪刀式”消防楼梯排列的八个小单元。每层八个单元中有七个是一室户（bedsit），由厨房、卫生间和一个起居兼卧室的单一空间组成，只朝北、东或西一个方向开窗。第八个是一居室。朝南的单元在第二个方向上开了窗，获得一些日照，但所有单元都没有阳台，层高也相对较低。底层的电梯厅、信箱区、办公室、休息室和社区活动室提供了额外的共享设施。在室外，一片围起来的宽敞绿化区，配有座椅、遮蔽物和水景，构成了一个安全的公共花园（图 12）。

The four slab blocks run north to south, with units facing either east or west, which maximizes solar exposure and makes westward-facing units especially subject to intense afternoon solar gain and overheating. The strictness of construction efficiencies does not appear to have allowed for windows to face north or south at end units and none of the units enjoy proper, natural crossventilation. The units are served by long, narrow, highly internalized corridors with turns at the lift lobby preventing a straight line of view from the lift to the unit entry. A laundry and garbage chute are located at each end of the floor plate for convenience. The double-loaded corridor arrangement means that the building section is relatively deep compared to previous buildings but would still be considered very slender by today’s standards which can typically be almost double, up to 24 m. Almost all kitchens and bathrooms were located internally along the back wall of each unit, requiring artificial lighting and mechanical ventilation. Windows to bedrooms were wide, but with relatively high sills and low head heights. This is seemingly intended to create a feeling of safety at height but limits a good outlook. Taller sliding glass living room doors to small squarish balconies provide some additional glazing but visual access to outside is diminished by a solid balustrade detail (Figures 13 and 14).

四栋板楼南北走向，单元朝东或朝西，这使日照最大化，也让朝西的单元在午后尤其容易受强烈的太阳得热而过热。严格追求建造效率，似乎没有给端头单元留出朝北或朝南开窗的余地，所有单元都没有真正的自然穿堂风。单元由狭长、高度内向化的走廊服务，走廊在电梯厅处转折，使人从电梯无法一眼看到单元入口。每层两端各设一个洗衣间和垃圾槽以便使用。双侧走廊（double-loaded corridor）的布置意味着楼体剖面比以前的建筑深，但按今天的标准仍算非常纤细，今天通常几乎是它的两倍，可达 24 米。几乎所有厨房和卫生间都沿各单元的后墙布置在内部，需要人工照明和机械通风。卧室窗户很宽，但窗台较高、窗顶较低。这样做似乎是为了在高处营造安全感，却限制了良好的视野。通往小方形阳台的较高的起居室玻璃推拉门提供了一些额外的采光面，但实心的栏板设计削弱了向外看的视线（图 13 和图 14）。

In 1972, the Housing Commission announced plans to extend the site to the east and build more than two thousand more dwellings in Waterloo, including up to six more 30-storey towers to a different design. This was opposed by the newly formed South Sydney Action Group. In 1973, the Commonwealth intervened in State and Local housing provisions through its Department of Urban and Regional Development with a change in policy to protect and rehabilitate inner-city suburbs of terrace housing in places such as Glebe and Woolloomooloo. In 1974, the Builders Labourers Federation placed a ‘green ban’ on further demolition of low-income housing in Waterloo. In response, the Housing Commission commenced a detailed consultative process with residents resulting in their activity being redirected towards an extensive programme of rehabilitation of existing housing complimented by architecturally compatible new infill housing (Figure 15).

1972 年，住房委员会宣布计划把场地向东扩展，在 Waterloo 再建两千多套住宅，包括最多六栋采用不同设计的 30 层塔楼。这遭到新成立的南悉尼行动小组（South Sydney Action Group）的反对。1973 年，联邦政府通过其城市与区域发展部（Department of Urban and Regional Development）介入州和地方的住房供给，政策转向保护和修复 Glebe、Woolloomooloo 等地的联排住宅内城郊区。1974 年，建筑工人联合会（Builders Labourers Federation）对 Waterloo 进一步拆除低收入住房实施了“绿色禁令”（green ban）。作为回应，住房委员会与居民展开了详细的协商程序，其工作因此转向一项大规模的现有住房修复计划，并辅以建筑上相协调的新建填充住宅（图 15）。

More dwellings were added to the southern end of the estate right up until the early 1980s, including the architecturally striking Drysdale and Dobell developments (also known as ‘Artists Corner’) designed by Tao Gofers and Penny Rosier of the NSW Housing Commission. But in many ways, the green ban and federal engagement in the mid-1970s decisively shifted the trajectory of public housing development in Sydney. The quarter century of expansive growth that created the Waterloo estate was over.

直到 1980 年代初，公屋区南端仍在增建住宅，包括由 NSW 住房委员会的 Tao Gofers 和 Penny Rosier 设计、建筑上引人注目的 Drysdale 和 Dobell 开发项目（也称“艺术家之角”，Artists Corner）。但在很多方面，1970 年代中期的绿色禁令和联邦介入决定性地改变了悉尼公共住房开发的轨迹。造就 Waterloo 公屋区的那四分之一个世纪的扩张式增长结束了。

It had been a period of energetic ambition and growing capacity for public housing that left a diverse built legacy, most of it still physically intact and still inhabited. But how should we understand and evaluate that legacy? If we were to listen to residents who live in the buildings we have just described, it is quite likely that the current plans for estate redevelopment would not go ahead. Similarly, if we look to the NSW state government’s own measures for what constitutes good housing, the options for improving the estate’s housing stock appear quite different to what have been presented thus far. The government has not publicly presented a systematic analysis of how the housing on the Waterloo estate measures up against their own standards. Using a series of Wellbeing Criteria that are discussed in the next section, we have attempted to do this and presented the results in Table 1.

那是一个公共住房雄心勃勃、能力不断增长的时期，留下了多样的建成遗产，其中大部分至今在物理上仍完好、仍有人居住。但我们应该如何理解和评价这份遗产？如果去听住在我们刚才描述的那些建筑里的居民怎么说，目前的公屋区再开发计划很可能不会推进。同样，如果按照 NSW 州政府自己关于什么是好住房的衡量标准，改善公屋区住房存量的选项，看起来也会和迄今为止提出的方案大不相同。政府从未公开提出过系统分析，说明 Waterloo 公屋区的住房按照他们自己的标准表现如何。我们利用下一节讨论的一系列福祉标准（Wellbeing Criteria）尝试做了这件事，结果列于表 1。

Evaluating Waterloo评估 Waterloo

There has been a growing effort in recent years to systematize and build an evidence base for good architectural design. This has partly been driven by a desire to influence design guidance used by governments and third sector actors to promote standards of environmental comfort and other factors perceived as supportive of users’ physical and psychological wellbeing. Much of the initial research for evidence-based design was developed for health settings, moving beyond the high modern concept of the hospital as a curative apparatus and provide settings to support the overall wellbeing of patients, and has since extended into a range of other architectural settings and situations. Researchers have demonstrated that views of and access to green space, high standards of air quality, and thermal comfort levels all have a direct impact on health. Well-designed buildings minimize mould and dampness, maintain comfortable air quality, and provide spaces for outdoor recreation and exercise. These qualities have also been shown to contribute to a reduction in the spread of infectious diseases, as the COVID-19 pandemic has recently highlighted, while supporting better cardiovascular and respiratory health.

近年来，人们越来越努力地把好的建筑设计系统化，并为之建立证据基础。部分动因是希望影响政府和第三部门所用的设计指南，以推广环境舒适度标准，以及其他被认为有助于使用者身心福祉的因素。循证设计的早期研究大多是为医疗环境开展的，超越了把医院视为治疗装置的高度现代主义观念，转而营造支持病人整体福祉的环境，之后扩展到其他各种建筑环境和情境。研究者已经证明，能看到和接触绿色空间、高标准的空气质量以及热舒适水平，都对健康有直接影响。设计良好的建筑能把霉菌和潮湿降到最低，保持舒适的空气质量，并提供户外休闲和锻炼的空间。这些品质也被证明有助于减少传染病传播（新冠疫情最近就凸显了这一点），同时有利于心血管和呼吸系统健康。

Many of these indoor environmental and spatial qualities have long been recognized by architects as fundamental biological and psychological factors that support human flourishing. A growing literature focusing on the idea of wellbeing has confirmed that many of these qualities – particularly thermal comfort and access to sunshine and green spaces – have an impact on psychological wellbeing. Other design considerations that become important in the context of psychological comfort include the provision of privacy and opportunities for social connection. General principles arising from decades of academic and industry research provide a basis for policymakers to arrive at a sense of what ‘best practice’ should look like, including for housing.

许多这类室内环境和空间品质，长期以来被建筑师视为支持人类繁荣的基本生理与心理因素。越来越多关注“福祉”（wellbeing）概念的文献证实，其中许多品质，尤其是热舒适以及接触阳光和绿色空间，会影响心理福祉。在心理舒适的语境下变得重要的其他设计考量，还包括提供私密性和社会联系的机会。数十年学术和行业研究得出的一般原则，为政策制定者形成“最佳实践”应当是什么样的认识提供了基础，住房也不例外。

In NSW, a combination of physical and psychological wellbeing principles are effectively captured in the Apartment Design Guide (2015) planning policy which establishes a benchmark of the quality that must be achieved in the construction of any new residential apartment development that is at least three storeys in height and contains at least four dwellings. While this document was created with the private housing market in mind, it is nonetheless applicable to all tenures. In the context of the Waterloo estate, it provides a useful instrument for testing claims that its buildings have reached the end of their usable lifespan or are no longer fit for purpose, as it provides a contemporary measure of what is considered acceptable in terms of overall amenity in new apartments.

在 NSW，身心福祉原则被有效地纳入了《公寓设计指南》（Apartment Design Guide，2015）这一规划政策。它为任何至少三层、至少四套住宅的新建住宅公寓开发设定了必须达到的质量基准。尽管这份文件是针对私人住房市场制定的，它仍适用于所有权属形式。就 Waterloo 公屋区而言，它是检验“其建筑已到使用寿命尽头”或“不再适用”这类说法的有用工具，因为它提供了一个当代尺度，说明新建公寓在整体舒适性上怎样才算可以接受。

To establish this benchmark, we thematically analysed the Apartment Design Guideline relative to the environmental factors known to have the greatest impact on resident amenity, and, therefore, their overall wellbeing (Table 1). Relative to the provision of natural light, fresh air and thermal comfort, the guideline sets expectations about how much direct sunlight, daylight, natural ventilation and natural cross ventilation should serve an apartment, stipulating window orientation, openability, size (as a proportion of a room’s floor area) and shading, as well as setting minimum ceiling heights and maximum habitable room depths. Recommendations to support visual and acoustic privacy set expectations regarding the separation between buildings, and the provision and placement of balconies, windows, and landscaping. Under the theme of liveability, we have grouped considerations related to physical accessibility and minimum areas and dimensions for unit, room, and balcony sizes. While considerations of room size are difficult to measure and have thus not been the focus of design-related research relative to wellbeing in residential environments, at least one study of tenants relocated within the renewal process of an Australian housing estate found that the provision of larger rooms was a significant contributor to tenant satisfaction within those relocations; this suggests a link between more generous interior spaces and psychological comfort.

为了建立这个基准，我们对照已知对居民舒适性、进而对其整体福祉影响最大的环境因素，对《公寓设计指南》做了主题分析（表 1）。在自然采光、新鲜空气和热舒适方面，指南对一套公寓应获得多少直射阳光、天然采光、自然通风和自然穿堂风设定了要求，规定了窗户的朝向、可开启性、大小（占房间面积的比例）和遮阳，还规定了最低层高和可居住房间的最大进深。支持视线和声学私密性的建议，对建筑间距以及阳台、窗户和绿化的设置与位置提出了要求。在“宜居性”这一主题下，我们归入了与无障碍通行，以及单元、房间和阳台最小面积与尺寸相关的考量。房间大小的影响难以衡量，因此一直不是住宅环境福祉相关设计研究的重点；但至少有一项研究，针对澳大利亚某公屋区更新过程中被搬迁的租户，发现更大的房间是搬迁后租户满意度的重要来源。这表明更宽敞的室内空间与心理舒适之间存在关联。

Design considerations aimed at supporting a sense of community include expectations around the size and quality of communal spaces; the design of building entrances to be easily identifiable and maintain a clear relationship to the street; and the maximum number of apartments per floor accessible from a circulation core. While design is not the main determinant in establishing a strong sense of community, spaces we might term uncomfortable can have a negative psychological impact, particularly around perceptions of discomfort and danger. Such spaces, in turn, can impede communication and a person’s resilience to irritation – both influencing a tenant’s likelihood of establishing and maintaining social contact with neighbours.

旨在支持社区感的设计考量包括：对公共空间大小和品质的要求；建筑入口要易于识别并与街道保持清晰关系；以及从一个交通核可到达的每层公寓最大数量。设计并不是形成强烈社区感的主要决定因素，但我们或许可称为“不舒服”的空间会产生负面心理影响，尤其是在不适感和危险感方面。这类空间反过来会妨碍交流，削弱一个人对烦扰的承受力，两者都会影响租户与邻居建立和维持社会联系的可能性。

In the remainder of this section, we assess the four housing types on the estate against four key types of amenity that broadly capture the objectives of the Apartment Design Guide. An analysis of the four main housing types contained within the Waterloo Estate – 3-storey walk-ups, 6-storey courtyards, 17-storey slabs, and 30-storey towers – confirms that some typologies go further in meeting contemporary standards than others (Table 1). It must also be acknowledged that design is a practice of multiple possibilities where balancing the many and sometimes conflicting requirements of any building can result in necessary compromises in some areas to optimize benefits in others. This is true of new construction that aspires to meet contemporary guidelines as much as it is of established apartments. It should also be acknowledged that not all design considerations discussed have an equal impact on wellbeing.

本节余下部分，我们按四类大致涵盖《公寓设计指南》目标的关键舒适性，评估公屋区里的四种住宅类型。对 Waterloo 公屋区四种主要住宅类型——三层无电梯楼、六层庭院楼、17 层板楼和 30 层塔楼——的分析证实，有些类型比另一些更能达到当代标准（表 1）。也必须承认，设计是一种存在多种可能性的实践，在任何建筑的诸多、有时相互冲突的要求之间取得平衡，可能需要在某些方面做出必要的妥协，以便在其他方面取得最佳效果。这一点对力求符合当代指南的新建筑和既有公寓同样成立。还应承认，所讨论的设计考量对福祉的影响并不都一样大。

All four accommodation types compare well against the Apartment Design Guide recommendations in relation to access to light and air, and thermal comfort. The minor compromise across all four types is that ceiling heights are only 2.5 m, which met standards at the time of construction but is 200 mm less than the current design criteria. It is also worth noting that this is still greater than the 2.4 m ceiling height that remains standard in other types of residential construction. Due to building placement and orientation on site, the 3-storey walk-ups have less access to sunshine than the other housing types, with less than half of dwellings able to receive a minimum of 2 h of direct sunlight between 9am and 3pm at mid-winter. However, this compromise may be partially mitigated by the ease of access to substantial outdoor greenspace from this housing type. In respect of the 17-storey slabs and 30-storey towers, the inclusion of double-loaded corridors and/or single-aspect units present a much larger compromise relative to enabling the cross-ventilation of these units (noting that natural cross ventilation is deemed-to-comply above the ninth storey due to greater wind speeds at height). None of the four building types appear to provide adequate sun shading to windows, although this could be easily addressed through retrofitting externally.

在采光与通风以及热舒适方面，四种住宅类型对照《公寓设计指南》的建议都表现良好。四种类型共同的小妥协是层高只有 2.5 米：在建造时符合标准，但比现行设计标准低 200 毫米。也值得指出，这仍高于其他类型住宅建筑中至今仍属标准的 2.4 米层高。由于建筑在场地上的位置和朝向，三层无电梯楼的日照少于其他住宅类型：冬至日上午 9 点至下午 3 点之间能获得至少 2 小时直射阳光的住宅不到一半。不过，这类住宅很容易到达大片户外绿地，或许能部分弥补这一妥协。至于 17 层板楼和 30 层塔楼，双侧走廊和/或单朝向单元，在实现穿堂风方面是大得多的妥协（需注意，由于高处风速较大，九层以上被视为自然满足穿堂风要求）。四种建筑类型似乎都没有为窗户提供足够的遮阳，不过这可以很容易地通过外部加装来解决。

In respect to visual and acoustic privacy, all four accommodation types compare well against the Apartment Design Guide with only minor issues arising. These include the open balustrades (instead of solid for privacy) in the case of the 3-storey walk-ups; and the occurrence of a second bedroom occasionally facing an external circulation corridor in the case of the 6-story courtyard building type.

在视线和声学私密性方面，四种住宅类型对照《公寓设计指南》都表现良好，只出现了一些小问题。包括三层无电梯楼的通透栏杆（而非出于私密考虑的实心栏板），以及六层庭院楼中偶尔出现次卧朝向外廊的情况。

Access to nature and a sense of community seem like harder amenities to measure. But the design guide contains provisions that are broadly supported by research. The recommendation that a maximum of 8 residences should be accessed from a circulation core is an important consideration, as research shows that encountering a smaller and known group of neighbours enhances feelings of psychological comfort and physical safety. In the 6-storey courtyards and 17-storey slabs, circulation cores are shared by between 13 and 16 residences, in the case of the latter, potentially doubling what is recommended by Apartment Design Guide as a comfortable level of social encounter. This discomfort is further exacerbated in the 17-storey slabs owing to the lack of natural light and ventilation available to those circulation spaces which are long, tight and largely internalized. While there are limited options for improving this situation in the 17-storey slabs, the retrofitting of lift cores to the 6-storey courtyard buildings has been proven elsewhere to be a feasible solution. In the case of the 6-storey courtyard buildings this could allow them to effectively become multiple attached buildings, permitting some units to cross-through the building which could improve natural cross ventilation as well as improve privacy to second bedrooms. The inclusion of lift cores would also assist these walk-up buildings to become accessible. Building entrances are another design consideration related to community and, for all four accommodation types, represent an aspect of design that would welcome some improvement with some design attention given at the street edge.

接触自然和社区感似乎是更难衡量的舒适性。但设计指南中有些条款得到了研究的广泛支持。从一个交通核最多到达 8 户的建议是一个重要考量，因为研究表明，遇见较少且相识的邻居会增强心理舒适感和人身安全感。在六层庭院楼和 17 层板楼中，一个交通核由 13 到 16 户共用；在后者的情况下，这可能比《公寓设计指南》建议的舒适社交接触水平高出一倍。17 层板楼的这种不适感还因交通空间缺乏自然光和通风而加剧，那些走廊狭长、局促，而且大多是内走廊。17 层板楼的改善余地有限，但为六层庭院楼加装电梯核已在别处被证明是可行的方案。对六层庭院楼来说，这可以让它们实际上变成多栋相连的建筑，使部分单元贯通楼体，从而改善自然穿堂风，并改善次卧的私密性。加装电梯核也有助于让这些无电梯楼变得无障碍。建筑入口是另一个与社区相关的设计考量；对四种住宅类型而言，这都是一个值得改进的方面，可以在临街一侧多花些设计心思。

Across the four housing types, unit sizes are between 10% and 30% smaller that the Apartment Design Guide recommends. This equates to a shortfall of 13–15 m across the 2- and 3-bedroom apartments for all building types, and a shortfall of 17 m to the 1-bedroom units in the 30-storey tower (noting that a significant minority of 1-bedroom units were consolidated to form 2-bedroom apartments around the turn of the century). Across all four housing types, balconies, where provided, are often inadequate in terms of overall dimensions relative to the design criteria; while none of the four accommodation types provide accessibility features to meet Silver Level of the Liveable Housing Design Guidelines such as a step-free environment, door and corridor widths and suitable bathroom configuration. Built-in storage within apartments is also lacking as a consequence of smaller unit sizes.

在四种住宅类型中，单元面积比《公寓设计指南》的建议小 10% 到 30%。这相当于所有建筑类型的两居室和三居室缺少 13–15 平方米，30 层塔楼的一居室缺少 17 平方米（需注意，大约在世纪之交，相当一部分一居室被合并成了两居室）。在四种住宅类型中，凡是有阳台的，其总体尺寸相对于设计标准往往不足；四种类型都没有提供达到《宜居住房设计指南》（Liveable Housing Design Guidelines）银级标准的无障碍设施，例如无台阶环境、门和走廊宽度以及合适的卫生间布局。由于单元面积较小，公寓内也缺乏内置储物空间。

While this analysis highlights some failings, what it in fact identifies is that much of the existing housing at the Waterloo Estate has fundamental design attributes that are supported by evidence and promoted by the NSW Government in its own endorsed contemporary design guidance. All dwellings have large windows to provide excellent daylight and fresh air to all dwellings; rooms are never too deep; and there is generous open space between and around the buildings with abundant deep soil area allowing for the planting of large trees. Despite requiring various additions and upgrades – some more critical than others – the idea that they are definitively inappropriate for contemproarry needs and, therefore, obsolete is simply not supported by the evidence.

这项分析虽然指出了一些不足，但它实际揭示的是：Waterloo 公屋区的大部分现有住房，具备有证据支持、并为 NSW 政府自己认可的当代设计指南所提倡的基本设计属性。所有住宅都有大窗户，提供极好的采光和新鲜空气；房间从不过深；楼与楼之间和四周有宽敞的开放空间，有大量深土区域可以种植大树。尽管需要各种增建和升级（有些比另一些更关键），但认为它们注定不适合当代需求、因而已经过时的说法，根本得不到证据支持。

Design considerations are never black and white, particularly given that architects and decisionmakers have access to design-based evidence that remains limited at best. For example, there is no definitive way of assessing the benefits of expansive city views available from apartments in the 30storey towers. Do those benefits outweigh the drawbacks of small apartment plans in the tallest towers on the Waterloo Estate? These apartments were all originally smaller than current NSW policy prescribes, and while some apartments have been consolidated to create larger two-bedroom units, most remain smaller than the guidelines recommend. Equally, it is reasonable to ask whether shared living spaces on each floor of the 30-storey buildings compensates for that deficit. Furthermore, we do not have methods to accurately quantify the impact on wellbeing of living with a ceiling that is 200 mm lower, or a balcony that falls below the minimum of 4 m × 1 m wide (in the case of a studio apartment) – two aspects where these apartments fall short of the Apartment Design Guide. Importantly, these small compromises should be considered in relation to the social disruption and upheaval of forced relocation. The possible adverse health outcomes are a particular concern for older residents of these buildings who are in general the most vulnerable in this respect and least likely to benefit from redevelopment.

设计考量从来不是非黑即白的，尤其是建筑师和决策者能获得的设计证据充其量也很有限。例如，没有确定的方法来评估 30 层塔楼公寓所享有的开阔城市景观有什么好处。这些好处能否抵消 Waterloo 公屋区最高塔楼里公寓平面偏小的缺点？这些公寓最初都比 NSW 现行政策规定的小；虽然部分公寓已被合并成较大的两居室，但大多数仍小于指南建议。同样，有理由追问 30 层楼每层的共享起居空间能否弥补这一不足。此外，我们也没有方法准确量化住在层高低 200 毫米的房子里，或阳台小于 4 米 × 1 米的最低标准（对一室户而言）对福祉的影响——这正是这些公寓未达到《公寓设计指南》的两个方面。重要的是，这些小妥协应当与强制搬迁带来的社会扰动和动荡放在一起衡量。可能的不良健康后果对这些楼里的老年居民尤其值得关注，他们总体上在这方面最脆弱，也最不可能从再开发中获益。

It is clear then that while the buildings on the Waterloo Estate have some deficiencies, the idea that they are definitively not fit for purpose is simply not true. With the possible exception of the slab blocks, most of the buildings on the estate could have their lives usefully extended and continue to serve their purpose in a way that supports residents with relatively modest renovation, or even with additions. With effort, even the slab blocks could be substantially improved through staged upgrades that would still be much less disruptive than what the NSW Government currently has in mind. Some upgrades of this kind have already happened. Units in the Matavai and Turanga towers, for example, have been combined. We also know that in addition to being less disruptive for residents, such retrofit and transformation strategies help to avoid the use of new materials and the emissions associated with them as well as reducing the amount of waste that goes to landfill as part of clearance-led renewal schemes. Unquestionably housing agencies and architects should be broadly pursuing the different forms of amenity that support resident wellbeing to the greatest extent possible. But equally, the question remains, does the government’s plan properly prioritize resident wellbeing? One would expect that the government has thoroughly assessed the risks to inhabitants as well as the projected benefits if it were primarily motivated by the interests of public housing tenants. An analysis of the discourse around the redevelopment case put publicly by government, however, points to other motivations.

由此可见，Waterloo 公屋区的建筑虽有一些不足，但说它们注定“不再适用”根本不是事实。除了板楼可能是例外，公屋区的大多数建筑只需相对适度的翻新、甚至增建，就能有效延长寿命，并以支持居民的方式继续发挥作用。只要用心，即便是板楼也能通过分阶段升级得到大幅改善，而这仍会比 NSW 政府目前设想的方案扰动小得多。这类升级有些已经做过。例如，Matavai 和 Turanga 塔楼里的单元已经被合并。我们也知道，这类改造和转型策略除了对居民扰动较小，还有助于避免使用新材料及其相关排放，并减少以清拆为主导的更新计划送往填埋场的废料。毫无疑问，住房机构和建筑师应当尽最大可能广泛追求支持居民福祉的各种舒适性。但同样，问题依然存在：政府的计划是否恰当地把居民福祉放在优先位置？如果政府主要出于公共住房租户的利益，人们会期待它已经全面评估过对居民的风险和预期收益。然而，对政府公开提出的再开发理由所做的话语分析，指向了别的动机。

Rationalizing redevelopment为再开发找理由

While improving housing quality is an objective for the Waterloo redevelopment, it was just one of several that motivated the project and arguably not the most powerful. Consistent with the redevelopment of public housing estates throughout many parts of the Global North, the redevelopment of Waterloo was also driven by the desire to deconcentrate socio-economic disadvantage and transform a stigmatized district into one seen to be more befitting its location in the highly coveted inner city of Sydney. Equally, it was a response to funding arrangements which severely constrain the capacity of housing authorities to expand their housing stock and compel them to redevelop existing landholdings via partnerships with the private sector, with the sale of new market-rate housing cross-subsidizing the delivery of social housing.

改善住房质量是 Waterloo 再开发的目标之一，但它只是推动该项目的几个目标之一，而且可以说不是最有力的那个。与全球北方许多地方的公屋区再开发一样，Waterloo 的再开发也是出于分散社会经济劣势的愿望，以及把一个被污名化的地区改造成与其所处的、在悉尼极受追捧的内城位置更相称的地方。同样，它也是对资金安排的一种回应：这些安排严重限制了住房机构扩大住房存量的能力，迫使它们通过与私人部门合作来再开发现有土地，用出售新建市场价住房的收入交叉补贴社会住房的供给。

The Waterloo project was devised as part of the Communities Plus program of estate redevelopment, which included ‘major projects’ targeting large estates with high land values, close proximity to employment and economic growth areas, good transport connections and, importantly, a history of relatively low-density zoning allowing for significantly intensified development. As recent work by Wynne et al. outline, the programme signalled the increasing relevance of land values and development yield to the selection of renewal sites, as well as to wider asset disposal strategies. A key component of the Future Directions for Social Housing strategy of the Liberal-National coalition government of the time, was that the programme responded to the long-term decline in Commonwealth funding and absence of state government funding by replacing and slightly increasing social housing stock at no net cost to the NSW Government. In essence, private property development on redeveloped estates would fund the replacement of, and a slight increase in, social housing. Rather than public housing managed by the state housing authority, this social housing would be managed by community housing organizations, capitalizing on those organizations’ exemption from paying Goods and Services Tax and their tenants’ eligibility for Commonwealth Rent Assistance (and thereby shifting the cost of housing subsidies from state to Commonwealth government).

Waterloo 项目是作为 Communities Plus 公屋区再开发计划的一部分设计的。该计划包括针对大型公屋区的“重大项目”，这些公屋区地价高、靠近就业和经济增长区、交通便利，而且重要的是，历来分区密度相对较低，允许大幅提高开发强度。正如 Wynne 等人最近的研究所述，该计划表明，地价和开发收益在更新地点的选择以及更广泛的资产处置策略中越来越重要。作为当时自由党-国家党联盟政府《社会住房未来方向》（Future Directions for Social Housing）战略的关键组成部分，该计划回应了联邦拨款的长期下降和州政府拨款的缺位，办法是在 NSW 政府零净成本的前提下替换并略微增加社会住房存量。本质上，就是让再开发公屋区上的私人房地产开发，为社会住房的替换和小幅增加买单。这些社会住房不再是由州住房机构管理的公共住房，而是由社区住房组织管理，利用这些组织免缴商品与服务税（GST）以及其租户有资格领取联邦租金援助（Commonwealth Rent Assistance）的条件（从而把住房补贴的成本从州政府转移给联邦政府）。

Waterloo comfortably met the Communities Plus criteria, as an 18-ha estate just a few kilometres from the Sydney CBD as well as University of Sydney, University of Technology Sydney, and Australian Technology Park. It is also only a kilometre or so from Redfern Station – a major interchange on Sydney’s railway network. Despite this, the NSW Government decided to locate a new Metro station at Waterloo, which had the effect of further enhancing land values and ensuring financial feasibility according to the Communities Plus constraints. The redevelopment of the Waterloo estate was announced with a letter to tenants from then-Minister for Social Housing, Brad Hazzard, stating:

Waterloo 轻松满足 Communities Plus 的标准：它是一个 18 公顷的公屋区，距悉尼中央商务区以及悉尼大学、悉尼科技大学和澳大利亚科技园都只有几公里。它离 Redfern 站——悉尼铁路网的一个主要换乘站——也只有一公里左右。尽管如此，NSW 政府还是决定在 Waterloo 设一个新的地铁站，其效果是进一步推高地价，确保项目在 Communities Plus 的约束下具备财务可行性。Waterloo 公屋区的再开发是以时任社会住房部长 Brad Hazzard 写给租户的一封信宣布的，信中写道：

I am excited to write to you and let you know Transport for NSW has announced a new Sydney Metro station at Waterloo, due to be completed by 2024. On my visits to Waterloo I have spoken to a number of tenants who have told me they like living in the area, but are disappointed with the quality of the ageing housing on the Waterloo estate. The new Metro station not only brings fantastic new rapid transport to Waterloo, it means we can rede- velop the estate with brand new and more social housing that meets people’s needs. […] The Metro station and the area’s renewal will transform the Waterloo housing estate for the better, building a dynamic new community with great transport, better homes, better facilities and more jobs.

我很高兴写信告诉你们，新州交通部（Transport for NSW）已宣布在 Waterloo 新建一个悉尼地铁站，预计 2024 年完工。我在走访 Waterloo 时与许多租户交谈过，他们告诉我喜欢住在这一带，但对 Waterloo 公屋区老化住房的质量感到失望。新地铁站不仅为 Waterloo 带来了出色的快速交通，也意味着我们可以用全新的、更多的、满足人们需要的社会住房来再开发这个公屋区。[……] 地铁站和该地区的更新将让 Waterloo 公屋区变得更好，建设一个拥有便捷交通、更好住房、更好设施和更多就业的充满活力的新社区。

Brad Hazzard（时任 NSW 社会住房部长）2015 年致 Waterloo 租户的信，经作者转引。注意：作者引用它是为了接下来反驳——下一段指出，《悉尼先驱晨报》报道的因果顺序正好相反：是想再开发公屋区才决定把地铁站放在 Waterloo，而不是地铁站带来了再开发。这不是作者的立场。

While Hazzard’s letter implied that the decision to locate a Metro station in Waterloo catalysed the redevelopment of the estate, the Sydney Morning Herald reported that it was the government’s desire to redevelop the estate that led to the decision about the Metro station’s location. According to that story, Ministers for Social Housing, Planning, and Police, as well as representatives of the state-owned Urban Growth Development Corporation, were advocating for a Waterloo Metro station as a catalyst for the project. These four voices persuaded then-Premier Mike Baird to cast his deciding vote on the NSW Cabinet Infrastructure Committee for Waterloo, ahead of an alternative station location at the University of Sydney. In addition to the opportunity to redevelop state-owned housing at little or no cost to government, the project was viewed as a vehicle for increasing inner-city housing supply, and a means of addressing perceived social problems in the environs of the estate related to concentrated poverty.

Hazzard 的信暗示，是在 Waterloo 设地铁站的决定催生了公屋区的再开发；但《悉尼先驱晨报》报道说，恰恰是政府想再开发公屋区的愿望，导致了地铁站选址的决定。据该报道，社会住房部长、规划部长和警务部长，以及州属城市增长发展公司（Urban Growth Development Corporation）的代表，都在力推把 Waterloo 地铁站作为项目的催化剂。这四方说服了时任州长 Mike Baird 在 NSW 内阁基础设施委员会上投下决定性一票，选择 Waterloo，而不是设在悉尼大学的备选站址。除了能以很少甚至零政府成本再开发州有住房之外，该项目还被视为增加内城住房供给的工具，以及解决公屋区周边与贫困集中相关的、被认为存在的社会问题的手段。

There is growing pressure and desire in NSW to increase housing density in inner city locations and private housing supply in general. While there are sound social and environmental arguments for densifying inner urban areas, it is also notable that significant government revenue is generated through property transfer duties and land taxes; that the then-government undertook a significant ‘asset recycling’ programme involving revenue generation and reinvestment through privatization of public infrastructure, land, and services; and that the property development and real estate industries have exercised a powerful influence on policy and planning decisions in NSW historically. Furthermore, in a planning system where government mostly is unable to do more than regulate the land use options of private property owners, large plots of public land like the Waterloo estate are rare ‘low hanging fruit’ for realizing these objectives, irrespective of the negative social impacts of redevelopment. The redevelopment of the Waterloo estate would add as many as 6000 new private apartments in an area seen as insufficiently dense for its proximity to the Sydney CBD.

NSW 增加内城住房密度和总体私人住房供给的压力与意愿越来越强。加密内城地区有合理的社会和环境论据，但同样值得注意的是：政府从房产转让印花税和土地税中获得大量收入；当时的政府推行了一项大规模的“资产回收”（asset recycling）计划，通过把公共基础设施、土地和服务私有化来创收和再投资；而且房地产开发和地产行业历来对 NSW 的政策与规划决策有强大影响力。此外，在一个政府大多只能管制私人业主土地用途选择的规划体系里，像 Waterloo 公屋区这样的大片公有土地，是实现这些目标难得的“低垂的果实”，不管再开发会带来什么负面社会影响。Waterloo 公屋区的再开发将在一个被认为相对于其靠近悉尼中央商务区的位置密度不足的地区，增加多达 6000 套新的私人公寓。

Recent political leaders in NSW and their policy advisers have subscribed to the idea that large areas of concentrated public housing produce negative social outcomes due to their concentration of social disadvantage and so-called ‘neighbourhood effects’ –a concept which contends that a high incidence of disadvantage in a local area is a cause of further disadvantage for the individuals and communities who live there. A detailed discussion of this highly contested concept is outside the scope of this paper. Suffice to say, it is an idea that, as Joseph Heathcott has noted, has been deployed by architects, sociologists, and planners alike and seized upon by political decisionmakers to justify the retrenchment of public housing. For instance, in making the case for the Waterloo redevelopment, Hazzard claimed that:

NSW 近年的政治领导人及其政策顾问信奉这样一种观念：大片集中的公共住房会因社会劣势的集中和所谓“邻里效应”而产生负面社会后果。邻里效应这一概念认为，一个地区劣势的高发生率，会给住在那里的个人和社区带来更多劣势。对这一极具争议的概念的详细讨论超出了本文范围。只需指出，正如 Joseph Heathcott 所说，建筑师、社会学家和规划师都曾使用这一观念，而政治决策者则抓住它来为削减公共住房辩护。例如，在为 Waterloo 再开发陈述理由时，Hazzard 声称：

The major plus of all this which is not necessarily given enough focus is that when you get a mixture of housing, private and public, you get an incredible drop in antisocial behaviour […] Also what appeals to me is that little kids growing up don’t just see their parents and grandparents not going to work […] They see people around them dressed for work, leaving home to go about their day, and they think ‘Gee whiz that’s what I can do’.

这一切最大的好处，也是人们没有给予足够关注的，是当住房混合起来、私人和公共混在一起时，反社会行为会大幅下降 [……] 另外让我觉得有吸引力的是，小孩子长大时看到的不只是父母和祖父母不去上班 [……] 他们看到身边的人穿着上班的衣服出门开始一天的工作，他们会想：“哇，原来我也可以这样。”

Brad Hazzard 为 Waterloo 再开发辩护时的原话，经作者转引。这是"社会混合能减少反社会行为、给孩子树立榜样"的典型说法，正是作者下一段要质疑的"邻里效应 / 分散劣势"逻辑：作者指出这种主张证据很薄弱，而且 Waterloo 所在街区本来就已是约 30% 社会住房、70% 私人住房。不是作者的立场。

It is important to note that social housing in Australia is a highly residualized tenure. The small stock and tight eligibility criteria result in an increasing number of allocations to people with complex needs. It is the combination of eligibility criteria, limited supply, and spatial distribution that leads to concentrated disadvantage. Yet government policy has focused only on the latter, with deconcentration via mixed tenure (re)development prevailing as the ‘common-sense solution’ in spite of thin evidence to support claims that it reduces tenants’ disadvantage at all, let alone more than alternative or complementary interventions such as higher levels of income support and social services. Furthermore, in limiting the analysis of ‘mix’ to the boundaries of an estate, the discourse of deconcentration ignores neighbourhood-scale tenure mixes – the more relevant scale according to several housing scholars. In the case of Waterloo, neighbourhood-scale mix is already approximately 30% social and 70% private housing.

必须指出，社会住房在澳大利亚是一种高度残余化的权属形式。存量小、准入标准严格，导致越来越多的住房被分配给有复杂需求的人。造成劣势集中的，是准入标准、供给有限和空间分布三者的结合。然而政府政策只关注了最后一项，通过混合权属（再）开发来分散劣势，成了占主导地位的“常识性解决方案”；尽管几乎没有证据支持它能减少租户的劣势，更不用说它比其他替代或补充措施（例如更高水平的收入支持和社会服务）更有效。此外，分散劣势的话语把对“混合”的分析局限在公屋区边界之内，忽视了街区尺度的权属混合，而好几位住房学者认为那才是更相关的尺度。就 Waterloo 而言，街区尺度的权属构成已经是大约 30% 社会住房、70% 私人住房。

Despite its subordination to other objectives, there is a stated desire among politicians and public servants to improve the quality and suitability of housing for social housing tenants in Waterloo. However, there appears to be some discordance between the statements of politicians and news media on the one hand and those of planning practitioners on the other. Recent planning documents claim that the estate’s buildings‘ have high maintenance costs and are at the end of their economic life’. They also note that more than half of the estate’s dwellings are two-bedroom apartments whereas two-thirds of households are single persons – problematized as a ‘mismatch’ in the context of a highly targeted and fiscally-constrained public housing system. They describe the estate as ‘an “island” in nature with roads physically disconnected, an a-typical block structure and built form, and typologies that are distinctly different from the surrounding areas’, ‘[a]bove ground car parking [leaving] streets devoid of social activity’. Yet none of these claims speak to the qualities of tenants’ actual dwellings, which Hazzard described as ‘terrible’.

尽管从属于其他目标，政客和公务员仍表示希望为 Waterloo 的社会住房租户改善住房的质量和适用性。然而，一方面是政客和新闻媒体的说法，另一方面是规划从业者的说法，两者之间似乎有些不一致。近期的规划文件称，公屋区的建筑“维护成本高，已到经济寿命的尽头”。文件还指出，公屋区一半以上的住宅是两居室，而三分之二的住户是单人户；在一个高度定向、财政受限的公共住房体系中，这被当作一种“错配”（mismatch）问题。文件把公屋区描述为“本质上是一座‘孤岛’，道路在物理上断开，街区结构和建成形态不典型，住宅类型与周边地区明显不同”，“地面停车场让街道缺乏社会活动”。然而，这些说法没有一条涉及租户实际住宅的品质，而 Hazzard 把它们形容为“糟糕透顶”。

The nearest thing to a publicly available assessment of the condition of Waterloo’s housing stock was conducted by the now-disestablished Redfern Waterloo Authority – the planning agency created by the NSW Government in 2004 to lead renewal throughout the neighbourhood, including the Waterloo and Redfern estates. The Draft Redfern-Waterloo Built Environment Plan Stage 2 created a redevelopment blueprint that was soon abandoned but which set the stage for the next two decades of state government planning for the estate. It claimed that much of the public housing in Waterloo and Redfern is ‘not well suited to residents’ needs and nearing the end of its economic life’. It identified issues with outdated facilities such as shared laundries and ‘layout, orientation, footprints and design [that] are inefficient and do not address the street’, leading to ‘limited surveillance of the public domain’ as well as ‘irregular siting’ that caused sub-optimal access to sunlight and ventilation and a lack of well-defined separation of public and private spaces. However, such criticisms were largely reserved for the estate’s walk-up apartment complexes, particularly as their lower density made their use of space ‘inefficient’; relocation of sitting tenants would also be more manageable and a greater uplift in density achieved. It is these buildings which will be the focus of the first stage of the estate redevelopment, along with the mid-rise Dobell, Drysdale, Madden Place and Camelia Grove buildings. Together they comprise ‘Waterloo South’, the precinct designated in 2020 to progress as a priority, before finalizing plans for the parts of the estate occupied by the higher-density towers and slab buildings.

最接近一份公开的 Waterloo 住房存量状况评估的，是现已撤销的 Redfern Waterloo 管理局所做的评估。这是 NSW 政府于 2004 年设立的规划机构，负责领导整个街区（包括 Waterloo 和 Redfern 公屋区）的更新。《Redfern-Waterloo 建成环境规划第二阶段（草案）》制定了一份再开发蓝图，很快就被放弃，却为此后二十年州政府对该公屋区的规划定下了基调。它声称 Waterloo 和 Redfern 的大部分公共住房“不太适合居民需要，接近经济寿命尽头”。它指出了公共洗衣房等过时设施，以及“布局、朝向、占地和设计效率低下、不面向街道”的问题，导致“对公共领域的监视有限”，还有造成日照和通风欠佳的“不规则布置”，以及公共与私人空间缺乏清晰分隔。然而，这类批评主要针对公屋区的无电梯公寓楼群，尤其因为它们密度较低，用地“效率不高”；搬迁现有租户也更容易处理，而且能实现更大的密度提升。正是这些建筑，连同中层的 Dobell、Drysdale、Madden Place 和 Camelia Grove，将成为公屋区再开发第一阶段的重点。它们共同构成“Waterloo South”，这个片区在 2020 年被指定为优先推进，然后才最终确定公屋区中高密度塔楼和板楼所在部分的规划。

While the Redfern Waterloo Authority took issue with the ‘unsightly … blank, unfriendly’ car parks surrounding the towers and slabs, it suggested that the ‘economic life of the high-rise buildings (8 or more storeys) are [sic] estimated to be a further 30 years’, and that, as such, ‘[i]nfill development will need to respond to these buildings’. A response from the City of Sydney largely concurred with this assessment, while also making the recommendation that the Dobell and Drysdale buildings ‘be retained and refurbished to save money, conserve resources and to retain a valuable record of examples of better designed public housing from the 1980s to be found anywhere in the world’.

Redfern Waterloo 管理局虽然对塔楼和板楼周围“难看……空白、不友好”的停车场有意见，但它认为“高层建筑（8 层及以上）的经济寿命估计还有 30 年”，因此“填充式开发需要回应这些建筑”。悉尼市的回应基本同意这一评估，同时建议保留并翻新 Dobell 和 Drysdale 两栋楼，“以节省资金、保护资源，并保留世界上任何地方都能找到的 1980 年代设计较好的公共住房实例的宝贵记录”。

Ironically, it is the high rises which attract the most negative attention in popular media, their stigmatization helping to legitimize redevelopment. This is despite the fact that redeveloping them would yield quite limited benefits in the terms articulated by the state government’s planning analysis, and have intense social impacts on existing residents. The estate has been described as a series of ‘grey concrete buildings … strikingly incongruous against the relatively flat, terraced terrain of their urban surrounds’, or more floridly as ‘Soviet-style’, ‘bleak, grey housing commission towers’. Like other high-rise public housing complexes, the towers are occasionally labelled ‘Suicide Towers’. The towers and slabs are routinely used as stock images in any story about public housing or housing affordability. Hazzard’s successor as Minister for Social Housing, Pru Goward (who was also his predecessor), described these buildings and those in the neighbouring Redfern estate as ‘honeypots’ for illicit drug dealing and use when announcing a Local Allocation Policy that would prevent any applicant with a drug conviction from moving into high-density public housing in Waterloo, Redfern, and Surry Hills. When the project’s proponents discuss the need for new social housing to be ‘tenure blind’, it is these buildings that they invoke.

讽刺的是，在大众媒体中招致最多负面关注的恰恰是高层楼，对它们的污名化有助于为再开发提供正当性。尽管按州政府规划分析所阐述的标准，再开发这些楼带来的好处相当有限，而且会对现有居民造成强烈的社会冲击。这个公屋区被描述为一组“灰色混凝土建筑……与周边城市相对平坦的联排住宅地形格格不入”，或者更夸张地说是“苏联式的”“阴沉、灰色的住房委员会塔楼”。和其他高层公共住房一样，这些塔楼偶尔被称为“自杀塔”（Suicide Towers）。在任何关于公共住房或住房可负担性的报道中，塔楼和板楼都经常被当作配图。Hazzard 在社会住房部长一职上的继任者 Pru Goward（她也是他的前任）在宣布一项地方分配政策时，把这些楼以及邻近 Redfern 公屋区的楼称为非法毒品交易和吸毒的“蜜罐”（honeypots）；该政策禁止任何有毒品定罪记录的申请人搬进 Waterloo、Redfern 和 Surry Hills 的高密度公共住房。当项目推动者谈论新的社会住房需要做到“权属不可辨”（tenure blind）时，他们援引的正是这些楼。

As such, the Waterloo estate is subject to multiple forms of stigmatization. Its stigmatization in housing and social policy discourses centres on concentrated disadvantage and the problems that purportedly arise. Its stigmatization in urban planning and design discourse centres on the outmoded characteristics of the earlier housing stock in the south of the estate, including irregular and inefficient siting and ambiguous boundaries of public and private space. It is stigmatization in the media centres on the newer, more visible buildings – the towers and slabs – which are seen as an affront to popular taste and serve to anchor the social disrepute of public housing tenants. The relationship between these discourses and housing quality is tenuous at best: none speak directly to the qualities of tenants’ homes. Indeed, stigmatization allows proponents of redevelopment to elide the question of existing housing quality. These discourses open up a powerful ‘reputational gap’, devaluing the present condition of the estate in relation to what it might in the future become, and thus help legitimize the proposed redevelopment.

因此，Waterloo 公屋区承受着多重形式的污名化。在住房与社会政策话语中，对它的污名化集中于劣势的集中及其据称带来的问题。在城市规划与设计话语中，污名化集中于公屋区南部较早期住房存量的过时特征，包括不规则、低效率的布局，以及公共与私人空间边界模糊。在媒体中，污名化集中于较新、较显眼的建筑——塔楼和板楼——它们被视为冒犯大众品味，并起到坐实公共住房租户社会恶名的作用。这些话语与住房质量之间的关系充其量是牵强的：没有一种话语直接涉及租户住宅的品质。事实上，污名化让再开发的推动者得以回避现有住房质量的问题。这些话语打开了一个强有力的“声誉差距”（reputational gap），相对于公屋区未来可能成为的样子贬低它现在的状况，从而有助于为拟议的再开发提供正当性。

Conclusion结论

Is the Waterloo estate’s housing stock among the worst quality and most in need of replacement out of all public housing in NSW? While it is impossible to answer definitively, there is no evidence to suggest that it is and it is certainly doubtful that it is the case. There are public housing complexes that are older than Waterloo, and several that exhibit just as many if not more of the design shortcomings with which it has been charged. Yet these are not currently slated for redevelopment; as we have discussed, housing quality is just one reason among several driving the redevelopment of Waterloo, and far from the most significant. The estate is a large plot of high value and publicly owned land, with a significant gap between ground rents realized by the state and ground rents potentially received through partial privatization and redevelopment. It also has a significant reputational gap, created through denigration of its present use and idealization of its future use.

Waterloo 公屋区的住房存量，是否属于 NSW 所有公共住房中质量最差、最需要替换的那一批？虽然不可能给出确定答案，但没有证据表明是这样，而且肯定值得怀疑。有些公共住房项目比 Waterloo 更老，也有几个表现出与它被指责的同样多、甚至更多的设计缺陷。然而这些项目目前并未被列入再开发计划；正如我们所讨论的，住房质量只是推动 Waterloo 再开发的几个原因之一，而且远不是最重要的。这个公屋区是一大片高价值的公有土地，州政府实现的地租与通过部分私有化和再开发可能获得的地租之间，存在显著差距（即租差）。它也有一个显著的声誉差距，是通过贬低其现有用途、理想化其未来用途制造出来的。

Waterloo is therefore selectively represented as outdated and unfit for purpose, in the sense of a disproportionate focus on the Waterloo estate in relation to other public housing estates and in the identification and articulation of only its negative characteristics that help justify its demolition. All buildings are tarred with the same brush, foreclosing rational assessment of the qualities of the estate’s housing stock and consideration of alternatives. As this paper shows, there are many redeeming features of this housing which, alongside the negative impacts of relocation on residents (and negative environmental impacts of demolition and redevelopment), should be weighed against the benefits of replacing it with homes that meet contemporary standards and expectations. A more fulsome evaluation of these benefits and costs suggests that retaining at least some of the estate’s existing buildings, renovating, and refurbishing, perhaps developing infill housing and gradually phasing out the established buildings over a longer time period (as well as building or buying new public housing elsewhere) could produce better outcomes. A new rationale will be needed in order for this kind of evaluation to occur – one that prioritizes the wellbeing of existing tenants and maximization of current public housing stock in the context of immense immediate and future need.

因此，Waterloo 被选择性地呈现为过时的、不再适用的：一方面，相对于其他公屋区，人们不成比例地聚焦于 Waterloo；另一方面，只识别和阐述它那些有助于为拆除辩护的负面特征。所有建筑被一棍子打死，排除了对公屋区住房存量品质的理性评估和对替代方案的考虑。正如本文所表明的，这些住房有许多可取之处，应当连同搬迁对居民的负面影响（以及拆除和再开发对环境的负面影响），与用符合当代标准和期望的住宅替换它们的好处放在一起权衡。对这些收益和成本做更全面的评估后会发现：至少保留公屋区部分现有建筑，加以翻新和整修，或许再建一些填充式住房，在更长时间内逐步淘汰既有建筑（同时在其他地方新建或购买公共住房），可能会带来更好的结果。要让这种评估得以进行，需要一种新的理由：在当下和未来需求巨大的背景下，把现有租户的福祉和现有公共住房存量的最大化放在优先位置。

名词与人物详解 (19 条)
概念 公屋区更新（estate renewal）

在澳大利亚语境里，特指拆除公共住房区、在原址建混合权属住宅。本文的作用：开篇就指出"更新"这个词本身掩盖了"拆除"。课程对照：Davidson 的新建绅士化；Lees (2008)。

政策/机构 Communities Plus

NSW 2016 年起的公屋再开发计划，在地价高、交通好、原分区密度低的公屋区，用私人开发收入交叉补贴社会住房，典型比例为 70% 私人、30% 社会。本文第"为再开发找理由"一节说明，地价和开发收益决定了哪些公屋区被选中。

政策/机构 Future Directions for Social Housing（社会住房未来方向）

2016 年 NSW 自由党-国家党政府的社会住房战略，Communities Plus 是其核心。目标是在州政府零净成本下替换并略增社会住房。

政策/机构 社区住房组织（community housing organisations）

非营利住房机构。本文指出把新社会住房交给它们管理，是利用其免缴 GST、租户可领联邦租金援助，把补贴成本从州转给联邦。

政策/机构 NSW 住房委员会（Housing Commission of NSW）

1941 年设立的州公共住房机构，建造了 Waterloo 公屋区。后来演变为 LAHC 等机构，今天由 Homes NSW 接手。

政策/机构 《公寓设计指南》（Apartment Design Guide, ADG, 2015）

NSW 规划政策，规定三层以上、四户以上新建公寓必须达到的质量基准（日照、通风、层高、私密性、面积等）。本文的方法核心：用政府自己的标准检验"不再适用"的说法。

概念 穿堂风（cross-ventilation）

住宅两侧开窗形成的自然通风。ADG 的重要指标；本文发现低层楼表现很好，板楼和塔楼因单朝向和内走廊而不足。

概念 双侧走廊（double-loaded corridor）

走廊两侧都布置单元的平面形式。省地省钱，但单元只有一个朝向、走廊缺采光，是板楼最主要的缺陷。

地名 Endeavour 项目

1970–76 年在 Waterloo 北部建成的高层项目：四栋 17 层板楼（James Cook、Joseph Banks、Daniel Solander、Marton）和两栋 30 层老年人塔楼（Matavai、Turanga）。媒体污名最集中的对象。

政策/机构 绿色禁令（green ban）

1970 年代 NSW 建筑工人联合会（BLF）拒绝参与破坏社区或环境的工程的行动。1974 年对 Waterloo 的禁令让住房委员会转向修复。课程/资料对照：Darcy & Rogers (2016) 讲 Millers Point 的后绿色禁令抵抗。

概念 地域污名化（territorial stigmatisation）

把一个地方及其居民整体贬低的话语过程，源自 Wacquant。第二作者 Sisson 的核心研究领域。本文的作用：说明污名化让推动者得以回避"住房到底好不好"这个问题。课程对照：Yrjänä (2026)。

概念 声誉差距（reputational gap）

Kallin 提出：贬低一个地方的现状、理想化其未来，两者之间的差距为干预提供正当性。本文结论用它和租差并列，说明 Waterloo 同时存在经济差距和声誉差距。课程对照：Yrjänä (2026) 用的是同一概念。

理论/思潮 租差（rent gap）

Smith (1979)：现行用途下实现的地租与潜在地租之间的差距。本文结论把 Waterloo 描述为"州政府实现的地租与部分私有化和再开发后可能获得的地租"之间的显著差距。课程对照：Gentrification 讲义。

概念 邻里效应（neighbourhood effects）

认为地区劣势集中会带来更多劣势的观点。本文称其"极具争议"，被政客抓来为削减公共住房辩护。课程对照：Segregation 讲义的恶性循环与邻里效应。

概念 分散劣势（deconcentration）

通过混合权属再开发把劣势群体"稀释"的政策逻辑。本文指出证据很薄，且只在公屋区边界内看"混合"，忽略了街区尺度。课程对照：Lees (2008) 社会混合批判；Segregation 讲义。

概念 残余化（residualisation）

社会住房存量小、准入严格，只剩最有需要的人住，使其越来越被边缘化。本文用它解释劣势集中的真正原因。资料对照：AIHW 数据，社会住房家庭占比约 4%。

概念 权属不可辨（tenure blind）

设计上让人看不出哪栋是社会住房、哪栋是私人住房。本文指出推动者援引这一理念时，针对的正是被污名化的塔楼和板楼。

政策/机构 资产回收（asset recycling）

出售或私有化公共资产、把收入再投资基础设施的财政策略，NSW 在 2010 年代大规模推行。本文把它列为再开发的背景动因之一。

政策/机构 Redfern Waterloo 管理局（Redfern Waterloo Authority）

2004 年设立、后被撤销的州规划机构。它的评估认为高层楼还有 30 年经济寿命、主要批评低层楼。本文用它说明规划文件与媒体污名的对象不一致。
